# International Journal of Research and Review (IJRR)

> > A peer-reviewed, open-access multidisciplinary academic journal publishing rigorous research across diverse fields with monthly publication cycles and double-blind peer review.

IJRR is an indexed, open-access journal committed to advancing global research through transparent peer review and broad accessibility. The journal maintains multiple ISSN identifiers (P-ISSN: 2454-2237, E-ISSN: 2349-9788) and is indexed in major academic databases including Index Copernicus, adhering to the Budapest Open Access Initiative (BOAI) principles.
